solution:
The correct answer is __**3 Only**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Explanation:**

 
• **Leishmania:** It reproduces by **binary fission**. Hence, **A - ii**.
 
• **Yeast:** It reproduces by **budding**. Hence, **B - iv**.
 
• **Plasmodium:** It reproduces by **multiple fission**. Hence, **C - iii**.
 
• **Hydra:** It reproduces by **regeneration**. Hence, **D - i**.
